notes.title: Wishlist UVSU - My new puzzle platformer
notes.content:
HEY .
Wishlist my new game- UVSU!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513270/UVSU/

Outsmart yourself, iteration by iteration.
You alternate between playing as the hero and the enemies.
There's no AI in this game- It's replaying what you did previous iterations.

Originally made for GMTK Jam 2023- the game won 3rd place!
You can check out the jam version here.

Join the Discord for updates and opportunities for alpha / beta access
